versionNote.zh: 版本以逐运行的快照记录为准（`environment.reportedModelId`）；不填单一版本号，避免把未独立确认的值写成既定事实。
versionNote.en: Version is recorded per run as a snapshot (`environment.reportedModelId`); no single version number is claimed.

evidence.zh: harness 报告的 model id（alias `kimi-code/k3`），记录在 phase-01 各运行的 submission.json；供应商确认属 Kimi 官方，但 provider-side 快照标识未经独立确认。
evidence.en: Model id reported by the harness (alias `kimi-code/k3`) and recorded in each phase-01 submission.json; the organizer confirmed the provider is Kimi official, and the provider-side snapshot identifier is not independently confirmed.

notes.zh: Phase 1 的 15 个任务由 Kimi Code CLI 0.42.0 以 thinkingEffort `max` 执行；每题一个全新独立单轮会话。运行有完整的工具调用记录（推理为明文），收尾审查为正常逐维度审查（非「无遥测默认遵守」）。
notes.en: The 15 phase-1 tasks were run by Kimi Code CLI 0.42.0 at thinkingEffort `max`, one fresh independent single-turn session per task. Tool-call telemetry is complete (reasoning in clear text), so the runs went through the normal dimension-by-dimension audit (not the no-telemetry default).
